description.value: Bledsticks are illegal modifications to credsticks that impale anyone who attempts to use the credstick other than its authorized owner. A bledstick is matched to a single authorized user's biometric profile when Installed into the credstick. If any other creature uses the credstick, needles immediately erupt from the sides and surface of the bledstick, dealing @Damage[1d4[persistent,bleed]] damage and drawing a sample of blood from the unauthorized user that can be used to identify or track the creature later. An authorized creature can disable the bledstick for any amount of time for up to 24 hours.
